items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: with, what's his name? Bill Whitmore, poor guy died. Yeah, Bill Whitmore died.

ctx.x: Yeah. I agree with that. He married another woman over in Pensacola, Florida, and Steve Loicano went over to visit him, and when the woman found out Steve was a musician, she gave him a cold shoulder. Didn't want him in the house. I guess Brown Lee had quit playing or something, maybe they had a fuss about playing. He's the president of the Pensacola local. Local, yeah. That's right, too. Because I played over there. Brown Lee? Yeah. Oh, that's right. Bill's smiling. Norman Brown. Norman Brown. Yeah, still…
with, what's his name? Bill Whitmore, poor guy died. Yeah, Bill Whitmore died.

I went down to his house in Miami. Tony Perrani and I went over there and we made some little records on him, a little machine, a little recording machine, you know, and he's got a lot of tunes, you know, he was always writing tunes.
